reason: All three Discovery pipelines resolved their due P0 coverage. Twenty-six material same-day signals were normalized without topic selection: ten AI-platform signals and sixteen GitHub-engineering signals; no same-day published-research object met the retention threshold.
reason_zh: 三条 Discovery 管线均完成 P0 到期来源覆盖。本日规范化保留 26 个实质性同日信号，未执行选题：AI 平台 10 个、GitHub 工程 16 个；论文与研究成果管线没有发现达到保留阈值的同日研究对象。

pipelines.label: AI Platform Change Intelligence
pipelines.label_zh: AI 平台变更情报发现
pipelines.reason: All 45 due public P0 platform channels were checked. Claude Code v2.1.248, published during the run date, supplied the retained same-day platform mechanisms; v2.1.250 contained only generic bug-fix wording and produced no additional retained mechanism.
pipelines.reason_zh: 45 个到期 P0 公共平台通道全部完成检查。运行日发布的 Claude Code v2.1.248 提供了本次保留的平台机制；v2.1.250 仅给出通用 Bug Fix 描述，没有形成额外可保留机制。

pipelines.label: GitHub Engineering Intelligence
pipelines.reason: All nine P0 daily repositories were checked incrementally from the prior-day checkpoint. Retained mechanisms came from OpenAI Codex, OpenAI Agents SDK, Google ADK and GitHub Copilot CLI; Claude Code changes were deduplicated into the AI-platform release object, while Gemini CLI and both MCP SDKs plus A2A had no retained same-day change.
pipelines.reason_zh: 9 个 P0 Daily 仓库均从前一日检查点完成增量检查。保留机制来自 OpenAI Codex、OpenAI Agents SDK、Google ADK 与 GitHub Copilot CLI；Claude Code 变化已去重并归入 AI Platform Release 对象，Gemini CLI、两个 MCP SDK 与 A2A 本日没有保留的同日变化。

pipelines.label_zh: 论文与研究成果情报发现

pipelines.reason_zh: 9 个 P0 研究来源全部收口：8 个已检查，1 个明确记录抓取失败；未发现发表于运行日且达到保留阈值的实质研究对象。

columns.label: Digital Employee
columns.reason: Discovery recorded eleven primary Digital Employee signals; Queue owns scoring and selection.
columns.reason_zh: Discovery 记录了 11 个以数字员工为主栏目的信号；评分与选题由 Queue 独立负责。

columns.label: Industry Architecture
columns.reason: Discovery recorded five primary Industry Architecture signals; Queue owns scoring and selection.
columns.reason_zh: Discovery 记录了 5 个以行业架构为主栏目的信号；评分与选题由 Queue 独立负责。

columns.label: Open-source Engineering
columns.reason: Discovery recorded ten primary Open-source Engineering signals; Queue owns scoring and selection.
columns.reason_zh: Discovery 记录了 10 个以开源工程为主栏目的信号；评分与选题由 Queue 独立负责。

signals.title: Claude Code restricted mode removes execution tools and ignores lower-authority settings
signals.title_zh: Claude Code Restricted Mode 移除执行工具并忽略低权限设置
signals.summary: The new restricted mode removes built-in command/code tools and WebFetch unless explicitly named, keeps file tools inside the working directory, refuses bypassPermissions, and ignores user/project/local settings files.
signals.summary_zh: 新的 Restricted Mode 默认移除命令/代码执行工具与 WebFetch（除非显式允许），把文件工具限制在工作目录内，拒绝 bypassPermissions，并忽略用户、项目与本地设置文件。

signals.title: Claude Code adds cross-session messaging across local sessions
signals.title_zh: Claude Code 新增本机跨会话消息传递
signals.summary: SendMessage and ListAgents now support communication between sessions on the same machine on Bedrock, Vertex and Foundry and when telemetry is disabled, creating an explicit cross-session coordination surface.
signals.summary_zh: SendMessage 与 ListAgents 现在可在 Bedrock、Vertex、Foundry 以及关闭遥测的环境中支持同机不同会话之间通信，形成显式跨会话协作面。

signals.title: Claude Code preserves prompt-cache and extended-thinking continuity across OAuth refresh
signals.title_zh: Claude Code 在 OAuth 刷新后保持 Prompt Cache 与 Extended-thinking 连续性
signals.summary: Tool definitions are no longer re-rendered after OAuth token refresh in a way that periodically caused a prompt-cache miss and loss of extended-thinking context in long sessions.
signals.summary_zh: OAuth Token Refresh 后不再因工具定义重新渲染而周期性触发 Prompt Cache Miss 与 Extended-thinking 上下文丢失，改善长会话连续性。

signals.title: Claude Code stabilizes ScheduleWakeup identity across resume and usage-overage state
signals.title_zh: Claude Code 在 Resume 与用量超额状态间稳定 ScheduleWakeup 身份
signals.summary: The ScheduleWakeup tool definition no longer changes between a session and its resume solely because the account entered usage overage, preventing a full first-turn prompt-cache miss after resume.
signals.summary_zh: 账户进入用量超额后，ScheduleWakeup 工具定义不再在原会话与 Resume 之间发生无关变化，避免恢复后的首轮完整 Prompt Cache Miss。

signals.title: Claude Code stops resurrecting stale background sessions after host downtime
signals.title_zh: Claude Code 不再在宿主长时间离线后复活陈旧后台会话
signals.summary: Agent view now preserves a stale background session's real end state after the machine was off and asks before resuming its saved conversation instead of implicitly resurrecting it.
signals.summary_zh: 机器长时间离线后，Agent View 会保留陈旧后台会话的真实结束状态，并在恢复已保存对话前询问，而不是隐式复活旧会话。

signals.title: Claude Code surfaces invalid hook answers instead of leaving background sessions silently waiting
signals.title_zh: Claude Code 对无效 Hook 回答显式报错，不再让后台会话静默等待
signals.summary: When PermissionRequest or PreToolUse hooks return an invalid answer, background sessions now name the failing hook and schema error instead of remaining silently waiting.
signals.summary_zh: PermissionRequest 或 PreToolUse Hook 返回无效回答时，后台会话会显示具体 Hook 与 Schema Error，不再静默停在等待状态。

signals.title: Claude Code retries headersHelper authentication before falling into OAuth discovery
signals.title_zh: Claude Code 在进入 OAuth Discovery 前先重试 headersHelper 认证
signals.summary: An MCP server whose headersHelper supplies Authorization now re-runs the helper and retries after a 401 instead of incorrectly entering OAuth discovery.
signals.summary_zh: 当 MCP Server 的 headersHelper 提供 Authorization Header 时，401 后会重新运行 Helper 并重试，而不是错误进入 OAuth Discovery。

signals.title: Claude Code background sessions now hold worktree locks while running
signals.title_zh: Claude Code 后台会话运行期间持有 Worktree Lock
signals.summary: A backgrounded worktree session retains the worktree lock for its lifetime so cleanup and git worktree remove cannot detach its active checkout.
signals.summary_zh: 后台 Worktree 会话在运行期间持续持有 Worktree Lock，使清理流程与 git worktree remove 不会移除其正在使用的 Checkout。

signals.title: Claude Code treats invalid cross-session inbound policy as a governed hold or refusal
signals.title_zh: Claude Code 将无效跨会话入站策略处理为受治理的 Hold 或 Refusal
signals.summary: Invalid crossSessionInbound values are no longer silently ignored: user settings warn and hold messages, while managed settings refuse inbound messages until corrected.
signals.summary_zh: 无效 crossSessionInbound 值不再被静默忽略：用户设置会告警并暂存消息，Managed Settings 则在修复前拒绝入站消息。

signals.title: Claude Code Remote Control restores permission and message visibility after silent reconnect
signals.title_zh: Claude Code Remote Control 在静默重连后恢复权限提示与消息可见性
signals.summary: Remote Control sessions no longer intermittently lose permission prompts or the latest messages on the connected device after the CLI silently reconnects.
signals.summary_zh: CLI 静默重连后，Remote Control Session 不再偶发丢失已连接设备上的权限提示或最新消息，改善远程协作状态连续性。

signals.title: OpenAI Agents SDK recovers resumed handoffs after session append failures
signals.title_zh: OpenAI Agents SDK 在 Session Append 失败后恢复已 Resume 的 Handoff
signals.summary: The session path now recovers resumed agent handoffs when appending session state fails, strengthening recovery across a handoff persistence boundary.
signals.summary_zh: Session Path 现在能在追加 Session State 失败时恢复已 Resume 的 Agent Handoff，强化 Handoff 持久化边界上的恢复能力。

signals.title: Codex applies plugin app/MCP routing policy to unauthenticated reads
signals.title_zh: Codex 对未认证 Plugin Read 同样应用 App/MCP Routing Policy
signals.summary: Unauthenticated plugin reads now still apply the app/MCP routing policy, omitting unavailable app declarations while retaining valid MCP alternatives instead of exposing a capability set disconnected from authentication state.
signals.summary_zh: 未认证 Plugin Read 现在也应用 App/MCP Routing Policy：不可用 App Declaration 会被移除，但有效 MCP Alternative 仍被保留，避免 Capability Set 与认证状态脱节。

signals.title: Codex retries only confirmed remote registration conflicts while preserving identity and session state
signals.title_zh: Codex 仅重试已确认的远端注册冲突，并保留身份与 Session State
signals.summary: Remote environment registration now retries only explicit registration_conflict responses with jittered backoff, keeps waits cancellable, and preserves Noise identity plus initialized session state across successful recovery.
signals.summary_zh: Remote Environment Registration 仅对明确 registration_conflict 响应执行带抖动退避的重试，等待过程可取消，并在成功恢复时保留 Noise Identity 与已初始化 Session State。

signals.title: Codex aligns deny-read policy matching with executor path semantics and fails closed on ambiguity
signals.title_zh: Codex 将 Deny-read Policy 与 Executor Path Semantics 对齐，并对歧义 Fail Closed
signals.summary: Read-deny roots and globs are now prepared using the target executor's path convention, with fail-closed behavior for malformed paths, incompatible conventions, unresolved home-relative patterns and invalid globs.
signals.summary_zh: Read-deny Root 与 Glob 现在按目标 Executor 的 Path Convention 解析；Malformed Path、Path Convention 不兼容、Home-relative Pattern 无法解析或 Glob 无效时均 Fail Closed。

signals.title: Codex lets extensions inspect or replace MCP results before completion publication
signals.title_zh: Codex 允许 Extension 在 MCP Completion 发布前检查或替换结果
signals.summary: A new MCP result lifecycle contributor runs before completion publication and model-input preparation, giving extensions bounded access to executed-tool context and mutable success/error results.
signals.summary_zh: 新的 MCP Result Lifecycle Contributor 在 Completion 发布与 Model Input 准备之前运行，使 Extension 可在有界上下文中检查并修改成功或错误结果。

signals.title: Codex makes optional MCP startup grace explicit and runtime-refreshable
signals.title_zh: Codex 将 Optional MCP Startup Grace 显式化并支持运行时刷新
signals.summary: Optional MCP server catalog capture now has a configurable shared startup grace with explicit disable semantics and refreshable deadlines, making waiting behavior a governed runtime parameter rather than a hidden fixed delay.
signals.summary_zh: Optional MCP Server 的 Catalog Capture 现在具有可配置共享 Startup Grace、显式禁用语义与可刷新 Deadline，使等待行为成为受治理 Runtime 参数，而不是隐藏固定延迟。

signals.title: Codex binds cached Guardian approvals to current authorization state
signals.title_zh: Codex 将缓存的 Guardian Approval 绑定到当前授权状态
signals.summary: Cached Guardian classifications are now tied to current local and root authorization state so a stale risk score cannot continue authorizing an action after its governing authority changes.
signals.summary_zh: 缓存的 Guardian Classification 现在绑定当前 Local 与 Root Authorization State，避免 Governing Authority 变化后旧 Risk Score 继续授权动作。

signals.title: Codex preserves restored permission profiles and rejects lossy sandbox projections
signals.title_zh: Codex 保留恢复后的 Permission Profile，并拒绝有损 Sandbox Projection
signals.summary: Restored app-server threads keep their original permission profiles instead of projecting them into potentially lossy legacy sandbox modes; directory changes are rejected when safe representation is impossible.
signals.summary_zh: 恢复的 App-server Thread 保留原始 Permission Profile，而不是投影为可能有损的 Legacy Sandbox Mode；无法安全表示时会拒绝目录切换。

signals.title: Codex accounts descendant subagent token use against the root goal budget
signals.title_zh: Codex 将后代 Subagent Token 使用计入 Root Goal Budget
signals.summary: Token use by children and nested subagents is now rolled into the active root goal during active and idle accounting, so delegation cannot escape the governing goal's token budget.
signals.summary_zh: Child 与 Nested Subagent 的 Token 使用现在会在 Active 与 Idle Accounting 中汇总到当前 Root Goal，使委派无法绕开根目标的 Token Budget。

signals.title: Google ADK prevents child-branch user events from moving the invocation root
signals.title_zh: Google ADK 阻止子分支 User Event 移动 Invocation Root
signals.summary: A user event stamped on a child branch can no longer move the invocation root, tightening ownership and lineage semantics across branched workflows.
signals.summary_zh: 标记在 Child Branch 上的 User Event 不再能够移动 Invocation Root，强化分支 Workflow 中的 Ownership 与 Lineage 语义。

signals.title: Google ADK preserves upstream HTTP status and details in workflow node failures
signals.title_zh: Google ADK 在 Workflow Node Failure 中保留上游 HTTP Status 与 Details
signals.summary: Workflow failures now propagate upstream canonical status and details such as PERMISSION_DENIED instead of replacing them with Python exception class names, preserving failure causality for downstream recovery.
signals.summary_zh: Workflow Failure 现在传播上游规范 Status 与 Details（如 PERMISSION_DENIED），而不是用 Python Exception Class Name 覆盖，从而为后续恢复保留 Failure Causality。

signals.title: Google ADK preserves Gemini thought signatures through interaction history
signals.title_zh: Google ADK 在 Interaction History 中保留 Gemini Thought Signature
signals.summary: Opaque Gemini 3 thought signatures returned with function calls are now stored and echoed back verbatim in follow-up history, preserving protocol continuity required by the model.
signals.summary_zh: Gemini 3 随 Function Call 返回的 Opaque Thought Signature 现在会写入历史并在后续请求中原样回传，保持模型要求的协议连续性。

signals.title: GitHub Copilot CLI offers restoration for sessions left open by a crashed or vanished CLI
signals.title_zh: GitHub Copilot CLI 可恢复因 CLI 崩溃或消失而遗留的开放会话
signals.summary: Startup now offers to restore sessions that remained open when their CLI disappeared, turning crash or machine-restart recovery into an explicit session lifecycle path.
signals.summary_zh: 启动时现在会主动提供恢复 CLI 消失时仍处于 Open 状态的 Session，把 Crash 或机器重启后的恢复变成显式 Session Lifecycle Path。

signals.title: GitHub Copilot CLI exposes enterprise-policy-blocked MCP servers as Blocked instead of Pending
signals.title_zh: GitHub Copilot CLI 将企业策略阻止的 MCP Server 显示为 Blocked 而非 Pending
signals.summary: An MCP server denied by enterprise policy is now surfaced as blocked rather than spinning indefinitely as pending, aligning visible state with the governing policy outcome.
signals.summary_zh: 被 Enterprise Policy 拒绝的 MCP Server 现在显示为 Blocked，不再无限显示 Pending，使外部状态与治理策略结果一致。

signals.title: GitHub Copilot CLI forceRemoteSettingsRefresh now fails closed instead of using stale managed policy
signals.title_zh: GitHub Copilot CLI forceRemoteSettingsRefresh 改为 Fail Closed，不再回退旧 Managed Policy
signals.summary: When forceRemoteSettingsRefresh is enabled, cached managed policy is no longer served as a fetch-failure fallback; until fresh policy is fetched, the session uses a restrictive undetermined-policy posture.
signals.summary_zh: 启用 forceRemoteSettingsRefresh 后，缓存 Managed Policy 不再作为 Fetch Failure Fallback；获取新 Policy 前，Session 采用受限的 Undetermined-policy Posture。

signals.title: GitHub Copilot CLI preserves subagent hook lifecycle events in child and parent sessions
signals.title_zh: GitHub Copilot CLI 在子会话与父会话中保留 Subagent Hook Lifecycle Event
signals.summary: Hook start/end events produced inside a subagent are now recorded on that subagent session and re-emitted on the parent instead of being dropped on an internal session boundary.
signals.summary_zh: Subagent 内产生的 Hook Start/End Event 现在会记录在该 Subagent Session，并重新发射到 Parent，不再在 Internal Session Boundary 上丢失。
